hero.sub: Anyone at {name} can make a launch post or image in seconds now. Without the brand's context, AI guesses: the wrong colors, the wrong voice and claims nobody approved.
hero.prompt: Make a LinkedIn post and image for our Sephora Accelerate.
hero.generic: Excited to announce an amazing new feature! Our innovative AI solution will revolutionize the way your team works. Don't miss out! #Innovation #AI #Teamwork
hero.onbrand: Ten years of Sephora Accelerate, and 12 new founders joining the cohort. Meet the brands shaping what's next in beauty.
hero.disclaimer: Illustrative draft written for this sample, using Sephora's public brand guidance. Not Sephora content.

brandCard.headline: Meet the founders shaping what's next.

hero.headline: AI is making everyone a creative.
hero.headline2: That doesn't mean they're good at it.
hero.badCaption: Looks fine at a glance. Look again: the copy, the posed group, the colors.
hero.badAlt: A fictional AI-generated LinkedIn graphic: a posed beauty team, a blush wash and a misspelled headline

check.title: Then it checks the work
check.sub: Before anything goes live, Brand Check reviews it against {name}'s guidelines, flags potential issues, and shows which guideline informed each finding.
check.note: Brand Check runs on the context you already keep in Frontify. It's more than a prompt: it's a service built into Frontify, available in the portal and through the API. The image is fictional AI-generated work content, and the findings are samples.

asset.by: fictional, made with a generic AI image tool
asset.alt: A fictional AI-generated LinkedIn graphic: a posed beauty team, a blush wash and a misspelled headline

findings.text: The rose gold and blush wash isn't Sephora's black and white.
findings.recommendation: Use black and white for layout, and let product color carry the image.

findings.text: The headline has a typo ("Glow Up Your Beauty Loine") and a generic line with no expert voice.
findings.recommendation: Fix the typo and write like a beauty advisor: specific, inclusive and helpful.

findings.text: A posed group smiling at the camera doesn't match the photography style.
findings.recommendation: Use a candid photo of a real team at work from the photo library.

contexts.eyebrow: Use case 2 · What context lives in Frontify

items.label: Brand

items.rule: Black and white lead. Color comes from the products, not the layout.
items.ask: Which color should a social post lead with?

items.label: Creative
items.title: Photography
items.lead: Real teams doing real work, never staged.

do.label: Teams at work
do.note: Candid moments of people working together.

dont.label: Posed for the camera
dont.note: No staged handshakes or stock smiles.

items.ask: Can I use a stock photo of a handshake?
items.answer: Better not. The photography guidelines ask for **candid teamwork**, and **no staged handshakes or stock smiles**.

items.label: Everyday
items.desc: Short rules for email, decks and docs
items.title: Email tone of voice
items.lead: The short version of our tone of voice, for everyone who sends email.
rules: Say what you need in under eight words.
Lead with the ask or the answer.
Use the standard signature. No quotes or images.
items.do: Can you review the launch plan by Thursday?
items.dont: Just circling back on the below!!
items.askLabel: Before sending, in Outlook with Copilot
items.ask: Check this email against our writing guidelines.
items.answer: Two fixes before you send: **put the ask in the first line**, and **use the standard signature**.
items.from: Condensed from Brand › Tone of voice

everyday.eyebrow: Use case 4 · Everyday guidelines, inside Microsoft 365
everyday.title: The right tone in every email and deck
everyday.sub: Most of {name} will never open a brand portal. With Frontify connected, Claude inside Outlook and PowerPoint reads the Everyday guidelines and checks the work before it goes out.
everyday.note: Claude for Microsoft 365 reads Frontify through the Frontify connector (MCP) once it's set up in your Claude workspace. Sample email, deck and guidelines.

tabs.label: Email in Outlook
tabs.ask: Check this email against our email tone of voice before I send it.
tabs.intro: Three fixes based on **Everyday › Email tone of voice**:

before.subject: Following up
body: Hi team, just circling back on the below!!
We've been heads-down on Sephora Accelerate and there's a lot going on, so I wanted to share where things stand.
Can you review the launch plan by Thursday?

after.subject: Review the Accelerate plan by Thursday
body: Hi team, can you review the Accelerate plan by Thursday?
It covers the messaging, launch assets and timeline. Comments in the doc are perfect.

fixes.label: Subject:
fixes.note: say what you need. "Following up" doesn't.

fixes.label: Opening:
fixes.note: lead with the ask. It's in the last line right now.

fixes.label: Sign-off:
fixes.note: use the standard signature, with no quotes.

tabs.done: Updated. The draft matches the email tone of voice and is ready to send.

tabs.label: Deck in PowerPoint
tabs.ask: Is this slide built the way our presentation guidelines say?

before.title: Q3 results and some thoughts on where we go next with Sephora Accelerate

fixes.label: Template:
fixes.note: this slide isn't on the company template.

fixes.label: Title:
fixes.note: 14 words. Keep titles to six or fewer.

fixes.label: Bullets:
fixes.note: six on one slide. Keep it to three.

tabs.done: Updated. Slide 2 now uses the company template and follows the presentation guidelines.

partners.eyebrow: Use case 5 · Partner and agency files
partners.title: Partner files land in the right place
partners.sub: Brand partners submit work straight into {name}'s portal. Files land in the right library, and the assistant tags them and sets an expiry date in one sentence.
partners.note: Sample files, partner and library. The assistant acts on the assets you select: workflow status, metadata, tags and expiry dates.

partners.plan: I'll add the tags Accelerate and Cleared for external use, and set Available until to Dec 31, 2026, on the 2 selected assets. Say yes and I'll apply it.

retail.title: Every store knows what's running and where it goes
retail.sub: {name}'s store guide sits in the portal next to the campaign toolkit: the floor layout, the promotions running now and next, and where every sign goes. Store teams look it up, or ask the brand assistant.
retail.note: Sample store guide, promotions, sizes and dates built for this page. Not {name}'s own store standards.

zones.label: Window
zones.rule: Both windows carry the same campaign art. No prices in the windows.

zones.label: Gifting table
zones.rule: The first thing guests see. Only the current promotion, refreshed every Monday.

zones.label: Makeup
zones.rule: Gondolas run front to back. Each end cap tells one product story, never two.

zones.label: Fragrance
zones.rule: Testers at hand height. Gift sets go on the top shelf, facing out.

zones.label: Beauty Studio
zones.rule: The service menu board stands at the studio entrance. No product promotions inside.

zones.label: Skincare
zones.rule: Shelve by routine step: cleanse, treat, moisturize.

zones.label: Checkout
zones.rule: Queue fixtures hold minis and gift cards. Price strips only, no posters.

promos.name: Holiday gifting
promos.note: Gift sets lead the gifting table, both windows and the top shelf in Fragrance.

promos.name: New year, new routine
promos.note: Goes up after close on Dec 24. Skincare takes over the gifting table.

promos.name: Fall fragrance edit
promos.note: Came down Nov 1. Its signs expired in the library, so no one reprints them.

signs.name: Window graphic
signs.where: Both windows, centered at eye level. Campaign art only, no prices.

signs.name: Gifting table header
signs.where: Front edge of the gifting table, facing the entrance.

signs.name: End cap card
signs.where: One per makeup end cap, at eye level. One product story per card.

signs.name: Queue price strip
signs.where: Along the checkout queue fixtures. Product name and price only.

signs.name: Service menu board
signs.where: At the Beauty Studio entrance, on the right as guests walk in.
